_howto: Copy this file to <case-id>.json, fill it in, then add the case to index.json. Text fields accept simple Markdown: '#' headings, '-' bullets, **bold**, *italic*, [link text](https://...). Flags you can type anywhere in text: [VERIFY] for an unconfirmed reference or value, [NMH protocol, insert] for institution-specific practice, [REVIEW] for a clinical claim awaiting attending sign-off. Every question is open response: the fellow types, presses Enter, and the modelAnswer appears. Nothing is auto-graded. Delete this _howto line in real cases. Set status to 'released' when faculty review is complete, 'draft' before, or 'hidden' to keep it out of the library.
title: Presentation-based title (do not name the diagnosis)
subtitle: One line describing the patient and the problem as the fellow would meet it
objectives: Objective one, written as something the fellow will be able to do.

stages.title: Presentation
stages.narrative: Synthetic vignette. Keep patients, labs, and imaging fully invented.

questions.modelAnswer: Model answer with rationale. Mark anything unsourced with [REVIEW].

questions.prompt: A second question, for example one with a single best answer.
questions.modelAnswer: **Best answer: X.** Why. Then walk through the alternatives and why each falls short.

controversies: Where reasonable experts disagree, stated honestly.
discussWithAttending: Prompt one that pushes beyond recall into judgment and tradeoffs.

references.citation: Author A, et al. Title. Journal. Year;Vol:pages. doi:...
Author B, et al. Title. Journal. Year.
references.note: Citation from memory, confirm before release.

reviewChecklist: Every claim the clinician must confirm before setting status to released.
topic: The diagnosis or teaching topic. Shown only in the wrap-up after the last stage.
